messages:
alice: Hey — running into weirdness with AsyncClient + custom CA when setting base_url to our Dedicated endpoint.
ben: What kind of weirdness?
alice: The client ignores my /etc/ssl/redwood/ca-chain.pem; requests go out and fail with SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED.
ci-bot: [build 5821] test_py_async_client failing on staging (ssl)
dana: Are you passing verify= or using environment vars? We added support for SSL_CERT_FILE but not sure about truststore precedence.
alice: I'm on mac, tried export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/redwood/ca-chain.pem and SSL_CERT_FILE too. Sync client picks it up, async doesn't.
eric: Async uses aiohttp under the hood; it won't honour requests env by default. Need to construct ssl.SSLContext and pass as connector.
ben: Can you paste minimal repro?
alice: Sure:
```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
import ssl
ctx = ssl.create_default_context(cafile="/etc/ssl/redwood/ca-chain.pem")
async with AsyncClient(base_url="https://dedicated.internal") as c:
    await c.generate("hello")
```
alice: Even with ctx it still tries system store.
dana: Two things: 1) AsyncClient context manager doesn't accept ssl_context in our current API; 2) timeouts/retries on the async path are using default aiohttp RetryPolicy that recreates sessions losing connector settings.
ben: Oof. So the session is recreated and our custom ssl is dropped on retry.
eric: This explains intermittent auth failures too — when retried we lose Authorization header on redirected/failed attempts.
dana: Short-term workaround: instantiate lower-level session and pass it into AsyncClient, e.g. `client = AsyncClient(session=custom_session)`
ben: Code sample for session:
```python
import aiohttp, ssl
ctx = ssl.create_default_context(cafile="/etc/ssl/redwood/ca-chain.pem")
connector = aiohttp.TCPConnector(ssl=ctx)
session = aiohttp.ClientSession(connector=connector)
client = AsyncClient(base_url=..., session=session)
```
alice: That worked for me. Thanks.
ci-bot: Created issue #2387: "async client ignores env ca / drops ssl on retry" — assigned to @dana
dana: I'll add tests for REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE and SSL_CERT_FILE for both sync/async and ensure RetryPolicy preserves session/headers. Also add typing for AsyncClient.__aenter__ to return AsyncClient not Sync one.
eric: Also we should document recommended pattern for Dedicated/Private (custom CA + internal DNS) in the devex samples repo.
ben: Agreed. Could be a short sample: dedicated-onboard/custom-ca-async.md
alice: Thanks all. Will pick up doc PR when fix lands. :thumbsup:
